title: koeleria schroeteriana
intro: Koeleria schroeteriana, commonly known as Schroeter's Koeleria, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its use in traditional medicine to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria schroeteriana are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which can help soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
